actor: rival frontier-lab safety-architecture engineer (OpenAI, Google DeepMind, or Meta)
job: Build an intent-classifier front-end that routes sensitive request classes to a lower-capability model or degrades the active model's own outputs.
outcome: A production model that gates delivered capability on inferred request intent, beyond plain refusal or a static content filter.
motivation: Refusal guardrails leak capability and are easy to jailbreak around; intent-conditioned gating is the more durable, harder-to-bypass control surface.

task.who: the lab's safety / alignment engineering team plus serving-infrastructure group
task.what: wire an intent classifier to a route-down path or runtime output-degradation step
task.where: the model-serving inference pipeline and the safety-classifier subsystem
task.when: June 2026 through Q2 2027 (the runway to landing)
task.why: leak-proof, jailbreak-resistant capability control versus brittle refusals
task.how: intent classifier plus model routing, steering vectors, or PEFT-style throttling
